title: Learning More by Training Less: Uncertainty-Guided Progressive Contraction for Efficient Reasoning Post-Training
excerpt: Large language models have achieved remarkable advances in complex reasoning. However, scaling reasoning post-training with ever-larger corpora can substantially increase training cost without proportional performance gains. In this study, we therefore ask: how far can reasoning supervision be compressed without sacrificing capability? To this end, we propose an uncertainty-guided progressive contraction framework that concentrates supervision and optimization on the reasoning trajectories most valuable for learning. ai.why: Offers a technique for developers and researchers to optimize the efficiency of fine-tuning large language models for reasoning tasks.

title: Mix, Don't Tune: Bilingual Pre-Training Outperforms Hyperparameter Search in Data-Constrained Settings
excerpt: For most languages of the world, language model pre-training operates in a data-constrained regime where models must repeat their training data many times, degrading generalization. Two remedies exist: aggressive hyperparameter tuning such as high weight decay, and mixing in data from a high-resource auxiliary language to directly aid the low-resource target. ai.summary: Apple's research demonstrates that mixing data from a high-resource auxiliary language outperforms aggressive hyperparameter tuning for pre-training language models in data-constrained, low-resource settings.
ai.why: Provides a practical strategy for developers working on multilingual models with limited data, suggesting data mixing is a more effective regularizer than weight decay.

title: T3lescope: Arbitrary-Resolution High-Fidelity Generative Surface Reconstruction from Images
excerpt: We reconstruct high-fidelity 3D scene meshes from posed multi-view images without per-scene optimization, across scales ranging from single objects to large outdoor scenes. Per-scene optimization methods lack the learned 3D prior needed when observations are sparse or surfaces are glossy or transparent. Existing generative methods leverage such priors to complete geometry in sparsely observed regions, but typically operate at a fixed resolution over a limited spatial extent, trading spatial coverage against detail. ai.summary: T3lescope presents a method to generate high‑fidelity 3D meshes from multi‑view images at arbitrary resolutions without per‑scene optimization, handling sparse, glossy, or transparent surfaces.
ai.why: Enables developers to create detailed 3D assets from photos at scale, useful for games, AR/VR, and digital twins.

title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
excerpt: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which…

ai.summary: The paper shows that retrieving relevant GUI interaction history helps only the first decision in personal GUI agents, questioning the assumption that relevance equals applicability.
ai.why: Guides developers to design more effective context‑management strategies for personal assistants.

title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
excerpt: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising…

ai.summary: GroundAnything proposes using bidirectional diffusion decoding to achieve parallel visual grounding with flash‑speed performance, avoiding sequential latency of autoregressive models.
ai.why: Enables faster, more precise grounding for vision‑language tasks, useful for real‑time applications.

excerpt: Historical street-view imagery records urban evolution, but uneven coverage leaves substantial gaps in historical records. title: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
excerpt: As text-to-SQL systems move beyond demonstrations toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary source of errors. Ambiguity is traditionally addressed through conversational clarification, which is often inefficient, cognitively demanding, and poorly aligned with real-world user workflows. We propose structured disambiguation, a new paradigm in which ambiguity is resolved through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. We construct ARCS (Ambiguity Resolution Corpus for SQL), the first text-to-SQL…

excerpt: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds. Existing interactive video generation systems primarily emphasize following viewer instructions, while source-grounded video generation methods focus on aligning generated content with an external narrative or knowledge source. title: Thinking Inertia: LLMs Keep Thinking When Told Not To
excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly ship with explicit "thinking modes", yet their counterpart, "no-thinking", has received far less attention. These proxies are unreliable: disabled thinking modes may still emit reasoning, while long traces may contain filler rather than genuine inference. excerpt: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. excerpt: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) struggle with spatial, embodied, physical, and temporal reasoning. title: PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
excerpt: Language-model agents are usually trained by reinforcement learning from one reward per episode, and privileged self-distillation enriches it by letting the same policy, given a skill, teach its skill-free self through token probabilities.
